Photo 0 and 1 also show a sealed retail box for a 'DualShock 4 Wireless Controller' with Sony/PlayStation branding visible on the box.
Photo 1 shows the front/top of the same console with 'PS4' embossed lettering on the top edge and 'SONY' printed near the bottom, plus two USB ports on the front.
A black USB charging/data cable is coiled on the table in both photos.
Images have a 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'GADGETWURLD' watermark, suggesting they may be stock/catalog photos from a reseller rather than photos of the specific unit being sold.
No power-on screen, serial number sticker, or close-up of the console's physical condition (scratches, dust, discoloration) is visible.
Seller's text is cut off: '...comes with a pad extra pad is...' giving incomplete information about what is included.

read_from: photo 1 top edge 'PS4' text and 'SONY' text

claims.evidence: No shot shows import labeling, UK plug/PAL stickers, or any documentation; 'pristine' condition cannot be judged from product-style photos with no close-up of wear.
No photo or clip shows the console powered on, booting to a home screen, or disc tray functioning.

claims.claim: Comes with a pad, extra pad is...
claims.evidence: Text is cut off; only one controller is shown and it is still sealed in its retail box in both photos, so it's unclear if this is the 'extra pad' or the only pad included.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (HDMI port damage, disc drive issues, overheating/fan noise) not visible in static photos.
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and reading a disc if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Photos may be generic stock/catalog images (watermarked 'GADGETWURLD') rather than the actual unit for sale, hiding true cosmetic condition.
risks.proof: A fresh, unwatermarked photo of the actual unit next to a handwritten note with today's date, showing all sides including any scratches or yellowing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, i.e. at lowest plausible grade

risks.risk: 'UK direct' origin claim cannot be confirmed, which affects voltage/region assumptions and resale trust.
risks.proof: Photo of the official PS4 serial/rating label on the underside of the unit showing region code and import markings.

risks.risk: Storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is not shown, which affects price.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating label or system settings storage screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower/base capacity assumption

risks.risk: Controller is sealed in box: cannot confirm it is a genuine Sony DualShock 4 and not a counterfeit, since only the box front is shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the controller removed from the box showing the Sony/PlayStation logo and model number printed on the controller itself.

proof_requests: A video of the actual console powering on and running a game or app.
A clear, unwatermarked photo of the actual unit for sale (not a stock photo) showing all visible wear.
A photo of the serial/rating label under the console showing model number, region, and storage capacity.
A photo of the controller itself removed from the box, showing Sony branding and model number.
The full original text describing what exactly is included (number of pads, cables, box, games).
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Sony PS4 console bundled with a boxed DualShock 4 controller, but working condition, true cosmetic state, storage capacity, and whether photos represent the actual unit are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst-case assumptions until proof is supplied.
